title: Collateral Protection Insurance Notice and Placement Timing Standards
content:
These standards fix the clock for lapse, placement, deficient-proof and cancellation correspondence under Collateral Protection Insurance. The same figures apply in every plan, CollateralGuard Plan A through CollateralGuard Plan F; every figure is counted in calendar days.

| Standard | CollateralGuard Plans A, B, C, D, E and F |
|---|---|
| Record events that establish a lapse | an insurer cancellation notice, an insurer non-renewal notice, a policy expired with no renewal, and no initial proof |
| Days after the lapse is detected within which the first lapse notice is mailed | 5 |
| Minimum days between the first and second lapse notices | 15 |
| How lapse, placement, deficient-proof and cancellation notices are delivered | first-class mail |
| Whether an email copy of each notice is sent when an email is on file | yes |
| Whether lapse notices state the plan's monthly premium and deductible | yes |
| Days after a proof is rejected within which a deficient-proof notice is mailed | 5 |
| Days after placement within which the placement notice and certificate are mailed | 5 |
| Days after proof is accepted on a force-placed record within which the cancellation notice is mailed | 5 |
| Minimum days from the first lapse notice to placement | 30 |
| Minimum days from the second lapse notice to placement | 15 |
| Maximum days before the placement date that the coverage effective date may reach back | 30 |

## The figures on a hypothetical calendar

Taking a first lapse notice mailed on a hypothetical day 0:

- day 15 is the earliest mailing day for the second lapse notice;
- if the second notice is mailed on day 15, placement is first possible on day 30, which is both 30 days after the first notice and 15 days after the second;
- if the second notice is mailed later, on day 20, placement is first possible on day 35, the second notice's 15-day period then being the later one.

A "within" figure is a latest day, counted from the event named: a deficient-proof notice for a proof rejected on a hypothetical day 0 is mailed no later than day 5.
